item.description:
Michael McDonald - This Christmas: Live in Chicago 2009 (2010) Blu-ray



Multi-Grammy Award winner Michael McDonald has had a hugely successful career over four decades with firstly Steely Dan, then with the Doobie Brothers and finally as a solo artist. This festive concert was filmed in high definition in Chicago in 2009. It combines traditional and original Christmas songs featured on Michael s two Christmas albums bookended with classic tracks from both his solo career and his time with the Doobie Brothers. Michael McDonald s distinctive husky, soulful voice is perfectly suited to this material, which he delivers with sincerity on the more thoughtful songs and with a real panache on the fun numbers. This Blu-ray makes a perfect addition to anyone s Christmas collection.
